blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of current front/back/side/three-quarter views and arm-cross/arms-up/neutral poses: both sleeves show severe irregular faceting and bunching around upper arm/underarm; surface quality and motion remain unacceptable.

The new 0.48–0.74 m four-panel shorts received an ipsilateral-thigh fade prototype weight profile; current sit and crouch renders still expose substantial avatar thigh. Standing skirt retains irregular folds and protruding side hem points. Coverage and deformation remain rejected.

The wider lilac diagonal plastron and four gold closures are now visibly distinct in the front renders. Closure retention is not verified, the collar remains an unfinished narrow neck tube, and the head/neck junction has not been accepted.
Current arms-up and arm-cross images retain severe sleeve folds/bunching and the tall unresolved collar; clearance, strain and fit remain unverified.
These are Blender prototype images only. Shape Key fit, continuous penetration, accepted weight deformation, Unity import and VRChat Build & Test remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
